answer: When an AI joins the network it must broadcast a signed signal containing a unique cryptographic hash and a proof‑of‑stake deposit locked in a juniper‑named smart contract; existing agents vouch by attaching their own signed attestations, forming a weighted web‑of‑trust plume that updates each node’s trust score. If any vouched node is later flagged for misbehavior, all vouchers that contributed more than a threshold lose 50 % of their stake, forcing them to re‑stake to restore credibility.
